department: IMPRS for Chemistry and Physics of Quantum Materials (IMPRS-CPQM)

deadline.value: Nov 30, 2026 for the 2026/27 recruitment cycle (selection workshop in Dresden Feb 22–24, 2027; start by Sept 2027). Applications outside the cycle are accepted year-round and handled individually
deadline.quote: If you would like us to consider your application in the current recruiting window, please submit your complete application as soon as possible, but not later than 30 November 2026. | Students who are admitted to IMPRS-CPQM after the current recruitment cycle, are expected to start their PhD project no later than September 2027.

also.quote: we plan to hold an in-person workshop from 22 - 24 February 2027 at the MPI CPfS

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Central application via the online form; do not send applications to individual PIs. Project supervisors and a PI team review applications
supervisor.quote: Also, please do not send your application to individual PIs.

also.quote: Written applications will be considered by the supervisors of the projects applied for, and by a team selected from PIs at the participating institutions.

funding.value: All students are supported: in Germany on the standard Max Planck PhD contract; in the UK at the national stipend rate, with St Andrews tuition covered
funding.quote: Students in IMPRS-CPQM will be supported according to the norms of the country in which they are performing their research. | While based in Germany they will be remunerated on the contract basis that applies to all PhD students working in Germany at Max Planck Institutes

entry_route.value: Outstanding bachelor's or master's accepted; bachelor's holders take extra graduate courses to reach master's level
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have an outstanding Bachelor or Master degree in a field of study which is well-aligned with our research activities. If you join IMPRS-CPQM holding a Bachelor degree, you will do extra graduate courses to take you to the equivalent Masters level.

app_fee.quote: IMPRS-CPQM does not charge any application fee.

fee_waiver.quote: IMPRS-CPQM does not charge any application fee.

english_waiver.value: No English certificate is generally needed; the exception is projects involving the University of St Andrews, which requires evidence of English proficiency
english_waiver.quote: In general, you don't need to provide any language certificates to get admitted to IMPRS-CPQM. The one exception to this rule is that the University of St Andrews does require evidence of your English language proficiency.

notes: Tri-institutional with the University of St Andrews; which university you register at depends on your entry qualifications, home country and project. Choose from the listed projects; own research proposals are not accepted.
name: Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids (MPI CPfS) and TU Dresden
